caption: Anatomy of the /AG indicator: a temporary suffix on your (unchanged) call sign whenever you operate with your new General privileges before the grant shows in ULS. It is required once the Form 605 is properly submitted to the VEs and the CSCE is in your hand (§97.9(b)); on phone you say “temporary AG,” on CW and digital you send /AG, and you drop it as soon as the ULS record shows General.
spoken: the call sign K X 9 A B C with the slash-A G indicator highlighted, above three boxes: when you need it, how you sign it, and when you drop it
